items.text: I continue to urge the Senate to pass the Build Back Better Act, which would cap insulin prices at $35 per month. Americans should not have to pay thousands for a life-saving treatment. (2/2)

In honor of #NationalNutritionMonth, @HouseDemocrats government funding will invest in the health of America’s children by expanding Child Nutrition programs and providing school meals through the Summer Food Service program and the summer EBT program
$3.5 million for the City of Madera to rehabilitate a 50-year-old corroded pipeline responsible for carrying the City’s wastewater to its treatment plant

Big News for Madera! In the FY 2022 Appropriations bill, I secured $3.5 billion to rehabilitate a 50-year-old corroded pipeline responsible for carrying the City’s wastewater to its treatment plan. https://t.co/KtU1A24NhP

Cesar Chavez dedicated his life to ensure fair wages and treatment for farmworkers, who work tirelessly to put food on America’s dinner table.  He is an inspiration to many of us here in our Valley. Today, we honor his legacy and reaffirm our commitment to ensure dignity for all.

Today the House passed the bipartisan, bicameral Ensuring Lasting Smiles Act, of which I am a co-sponsor. This legislation will ensure health insurance plans cover necessary care and treatment for individuals born with congenital anomalies, rare disorders, or birth defects.

One in five Americans lives with a mental health condition. This #MentalHealthAwarenessMonth, let’s break the stigma by taking care of yourself and one another. Don’t be afraid to seek help if you need it, you are not alone. 
https://t.co/K11GP1uIRd

Today we celebrate the 57th anniversary of Head Start. Since 1965, this program has paved the way for over 37 million children by providing educational, health, and nutrition services. Thank you to the staff at our local Head Start programs for helping our children succeed.
In the wealthiest country in the world, no American should go hungry. The #FY23Budget bill will tackle hunger and nutrition insecurity with funding for programs like WIC, SNAP, and school meals.

September is National #RecoveryMonth. If you are facing substance use or mental health challenges, treatment is available and recovery is possible.

💻 Find help today: https://t.co/tYecMe6O4n

As CEO of the Fresno Economic Opportunities Commission, she has led the organization to achieve its mission of helping people become self-sufficient through job placement, education, family, nutrition services, housing, and health.

There are over 3.8 million breast cancer survivors in the U.S. I proudly cosponsored the Lymphedema Treatment Act, which would provide medicare coverage of lymphedema compression treatment items and reduce the financial burdens of this treatment. #BreastCancerAwarenessMonth https://t.co/JUMQgzsteM

I just voted to pass the Lymphedema Treatment Act to expand medicare coverage for the treatment of lymphedema. I am proud to co-sponsor this legislation so millions of Americans access the care and treatment they need!

This federal funding that I secured will help expand mental health services, substance abuse treatment, education and transportation services to help our most vulnerable heal and recover. https://t.co/oRDJFPhch9
Mental health legislation passed by Democrats will mean more treatment for substance abuse disorders and more funding to hire mental health providers. Programs will roll out over the next 5 years.
As President and CEO of the BLACK Wellness and Prosperity Center, she has dedicated her time to improving health outcomes for all women and infants. (2/4)

Approximately 42 million Americans rely on SNAP to maintain nutritionally adequate diets each year. Now is not the time to make cuts to one of the most important tools we have to increase food and nutrition security in this country. #DefendSNAP https://t.co/0VLzX31IZa

Yesterday, I toured Fresno Unified School District’s Nutrition Center, which provides healthy, nutritious meals to enhance students learning. Each day, they serve 98,000 meals including breakfast, lunch and snacks. https://t.co/7tQl2tpE5z
As we prepare to reauthorize the Farm Bill, it remains a top priority of mine to bolster nutrition and food assistance programs.

Proud to join @RepJimmyGomez and my colleagues in reintroducing the EATS Act. 

This legislation eliminates barriers and expands SNAP eligibility for college students, so they get the nutrition need to be successful. https://t.co/qRsDEwQWSQ

Dr. Kenny Banh serves as the Assistant Dean of Undergraduate Medical Education and the Director of Mobile Health & COVID-19 Equity Project at UCSF-Fresno. He is helping patients combat health problems and ensuring they get the treatment they need. https://t.co/6uNVWZvMAw

Had a great meeting with @SCActionNetwork to discuss nutrition policies and tackling hunger in the upcoming Farm Bill. 

In Congress, I'm fighting to protect SNAP and other food assistance programs critical to ensuring no child in America goes hungry. https://t.co/905G9GH4ZX

Expanded PACT Act benefits for toxic exposure symptoms are now available to more veterans. 

Even if you were previously denied benefits, the VA will review them under the new law. Apply by Aug 9 with the help of a VA-accredited VSO. Learn more⬇️ https://t.co/pzN07Lv72s

This week, I had a great visit to @FresnoEOCWIC, which provides healthy food, nutrition education, and breastfeeding support to over 27,000 women and children in Fresno County. It was great to see how these services are helping Valley families receive the support they need. https://t.co/DGnqAEBrXX

Exciting news! This investment in the West Fresno Boys & Girls Club will help build a partnership with Triple Play to promote health and wellness amongst our youth.
